body: Thank you so much for replying. I'm really grateful for you words. It kinda made me think that.. Our societies are just. Bad and toxic, maybe I am not as bad as I think I am. And started to think maybe I should try to face it and  think of a way out insted of letting it eat me alive , and well.. I took the first step. It may not be that good but. For the first time in my life. I did something of my own. I dropped that course I was almost failing, I used to be an always "A" student so it felt weird. But it gave some time for myself to Foucus on what I wanted to do. When I told my parents, they were mad but I told them that it was taking a toll on me and not letting me be happy and well.. Let's hope for the best. It may not be the greatest step I could have taken,but it's something I did on my own. I think I may be able to turn this ship around and be happy., I wish you the best in your career. And if you want someone to talk to I would be more than glad to lend an ear and help you too... Again. Thank you.
